summary: Backend-only testing for P2 OUTCOME_VERIFIED position reconciler and Mongo tz-naive datetime CI guard. All 34 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper separation of concerns between datetime_utils, position_reconciler service, and admin routes
The CI guard test (test_no_unguarded_mongo_datetime_math.py) is a clever heuristic-based approach to prevent tz-naive datetime bugs
Rate limiting implementation in admin_position_reconciler.py uses in-memory dict which won't persist across restarts - acceptable for this use case
seed_data_creation: Created test user test_reconciler_user@test.com for non-owner 403 rejection verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Position reconciler endpoints tested: GET /api/admin/position-reconciler/status (owner auth, returns pending/closed counts), POST /api/admin/position-reconciler/run (owner auth, 60s rate limit per actor). Both reject non-owner with 403, unauthenticated with 401. Scheduler job registered at 30-min interval. Broker and options order endpoints verified to exist and gate properly (404/403 without broker connection).
